messages.subject: Quote from Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are pleased to present our offer for a price of €6.05 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. 

To give you some background on our current situation and market conditions, AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. Lastly, PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to continuing our partnership with your team and supplying your needs from our extensive inventory.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (1)
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the delivery record data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. Likewise, we checked the price history data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We also checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. 

We appreciate your binding volume commitment of 94,800 kg over 24 months, which allows us to improve our offer. Material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. 

Building on your second package with the AS-14404 index clause and 30-day payment terms, we propose a price of €5.63 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. 

This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (2)
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We received a lot of material; we looked at what bears on this part. We have already taken that volume change data into account. The volume forecast you provided was already factored into our previous offer and does not change our calculation. While we note your reference to our material coverage, we must maintain the AS-14404 index clause for a 24-month contract.

Our current Angebot stands at a price of €5.42 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months, and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 60 days net and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: €5.51 per unit.

Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data. A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to? Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (3)
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your ongoing partnership with Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH. We appreciate your acceptance of the AS-14404 index clause, which provides stability for both sides. However, your proposed price increase is too small to bridge the gap to our cost realities. 

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. Our Angebot stands at a price of €5.42 per unit, a Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months, and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 7 days. We hope these terms allow us to continue serving your needs, and we look forward to hearing your decision soon.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH
